items.title: Paul Beaulieu Interview, 1960-06-11
items.q: And he even came here and wanted to look over it. ... Well, he was the one that played on that occasion, you see. And he liked the variation so much he came here.

ctx.x: He played the clarinet part on that occasion. And he even came here and wanted to look over it. Well, I wrote that clarinet variation too. Is he still alive, Mr. ?
Who's alive? Mr. Belrose, is he still alive? Belrose? What's the name again? Oh, he's a young fellow.

He has, him and his brother has a shoemaker shop, a shoe repair shop right around on Claymore, here, Ursuline. Well, he was the one that played on that occasion, you see. And he liked the variation so much he came here.
